title: dimerocostus strobilaceus subsp. gutierrezii
intro: Dimerocostus strobilaceus subsp. gutierrezii, commonly known as Gutierrez's dimerocostus, is a plant species in the family Thermoaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dimerocostus strobilaceus subsp. gutierrezii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of infections and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
